_doc: Per-move parameters for motion_check.py and legibility.py. Frames are anim frames (60 fps). contact = active frames; hold_window = frames where the strike holds its pose (recoil allowed, jitter detector off there); hold_frames_min = frames after first contact the effector must stay within hold_tolerance of full extension; strength light|strong (strong moves must recoil, not freeze). Class defaults: jab hold 1-2, smash 6+.
